say: Fifteen swabs in. Fifteen must come out.
One wrong pill name at home can undo a surgery.
Vani has stomach pain. Doctor Rao admits her to Ward Four.
The Watcher counts every tool. Sam three point one.
The Listener hears every order. Muse Voice.
The Reader checks every photo. Spark one point three.
She speaks the visit. She spells the drug. She taps Use this.
She plans the hernia repair and sends the tray list.
She speaks. Spark one point three drafts. She signs.
Photos reviewed. Questions answered.
Four photo proofs, one tap each. Wristband. Allergy. Vitals. Consent.
Ward tasks by voice. Doses logged.
The tray is short. Surgery waits. Sam three point one flags it.
Before: zero of fifteen seen. After: fifteen stained swabs match.
Fifteen out of fifteen. Zero missing. The count is saved.
Vani checks in. Her day plan is ready.
She types one name. The photo reads another. Spark one point three settles it.
Her record answers instantly. Her doctor answers next.
Card passes. Bag fails. She retakes the photo. Discharge unlocks.
Every AI result shows its proof and who confirmed it.
Proof, not promises.
No missed swabs. No wrong pills. No lost discharges. This is Lightday.
